name: Brazil

fees.name: Electronic Visitor Visa (e-Visa, VIVIS) - USA/Canada/Australia citizens
fees.validity: Up to 10 years for US citizens (multi-year for Canadian/Australian citizens), stays up to 90 days
fees.applies: Nationals of the United States, Canada and Australia (visa requirement reinstated 10 April 2025)
fees.notes: Fee of US$80.90 confirmed on official gov.br consulate pages; applications only via the official portal https://brazil.vfsevisa.com (operated by VFS Global). gov.br pages are behind anti-bot protection, so the amount was captured from the official page snippet rather than a full page fetch.

fees.name: Visitor Visa (VIVIS) - tourism, embassy/consulate sticker visa
fees.applies: Nationalities not covered by Brazil's visa-exemption list or the e-visa scheme
fees.notes: Base VIVIS consular fee could not be verified verbatim on an accessible official page (gov.br is behind a CAPTCHA/WAF); fee is charged by reciprocity and varies by nationality - confirmed reciprocity exceptions listed in reciprocity_variations (Angola USD 180, Algeria USD 85, China USD 115) from the official VFS Global Brazil visa-application-centre pages.

fees.name: Visitor Visa (VIVIS) - business
fees.applies: Visa-required nationalities; same VIVIS fee schedule as tourism
fees.notes: Business travel uses the same VIVIS visitor visa and the same reciprocity-based fee schedule as tourism. Base amount unverified on an accessible official page; see reciprocity_variations.

fees.name: Visitor Visa (VIVIS) - transit
fees.applies: Visa-required nationalities; grouped with VIVIS 'Tourism and Transit' category
fees.notes: Brazil has no separate transit-visa fee schedule; transit falls under the VIVIS visitor visa with the same reciprocity-based fees.

reciprocity_variations.note: e-Visa fee of US$80.90 via the official brazil.vfsevisa.com portal; these are currently the only three nationalities under Brazil's e-visa scheme (reinstated April 2025 after suspension of the visa waiver).
VIVIS reciprocity exception published on official VFS Global Brazil visa application centre page (Lebanon corridor): China USD 115.
VIVIS reciprocity exception: Angola USD 180 (official VFS Global Brazil page).
VIVIS reciprocity exception: Algeria USD 85 (official VFS Global Brazil page).

UK and Russian ordinary-passport holders are visa-exempt for short visits to Brazil (no fee). Indian nationals require a VIVIS; nationality-specific reciprocity amount not verified on an accessible official page - standard VIVIS schedule applies.
Visa-required nationalities on the standard VIVIS schedule; no published reciprocity exception found for them on accessible official pages, amounts not verified so left null (never guessed).

vfs.note: VFS Global runs Brazil visa application centres in multiple source countries (e.g. Lebanon, China, Angola in our data) and also operates the official e-visa portal brazil.vfsevisa.com. Published service charge is USD 13 (incl. tax, cash) at the Lebanon centre; China page publishes 27.8 CNY per application; Angola collects in Kwanza at local exchange rate - service fees vary by centre.

free_visa_notes: Most nationalities (including the EU/Schengen states, UK, Japan, Russia and most of Latin America) enter Brazil visa-free for tourism/business stays of up to 90 days, so no visa fee applies to them. Brazil is NOT a Schengen member. There is no visa-on-arrival and no eTA scheme; visa-required nationals use an embassy VIVIS visa, except US/Canadian/Australian citizens who use the USD 80.90 e-visa.
